title: ‘Bad Mom’ Gives Worst Excuses for Drunk Driving with Her Baby
description:
An Illinois woman was pulled over by Joilet police after someone called 911 on her for drunk driving. Taylor Harmon immediately confesses to drinking, and a few other things, before making every excuse in the book for putting her baby in danger. She pleaded guilty to multiple charges and was sentenced to 170 days in jail.
